events.title: Major Demo Update — New Atmosphere & Smoother Controls
events.summary: Major Demo Update!We've been polishing the atmosphere, UX, and overall visual consistency of the game. Here's what's new:New Main Menu Atmosphere Added rain, thunder, and periodic lightning effects to the main menu background — it now feels much more alive and atmospheric.Reworked Level Select Menu The level selection menu has been fully redesigned to match the game's core visual style.Notes Submenu Added a new submenu to the main menu where you can read all the notes you've collected. events.title: Bugfix #001
events.summary: What has been fixed:The disc on the penultimate training level is now collected correctly. Previously, the picking sound was played, but the disc itself did not disappear. The ability to re-obtain an already collected disc when completing a level has been removed. Now, each disc is counted only once. The "Restart" button now correctly restarts the selected level.
